notes: Light levels checked against the original at a street lamp, standing and crouched. All twelve test spots now match.
Melee attacks pick the right animation for the weapon in your hand, from fists to katana.
Movement speed in each direction now comes from the character's running animations. The old hand-measured table was off by up to 80 units a second going backwards.
Holding a weapon changes which animations a character uses and how fast they move.
NPCs react to what they hear: your footsteps, fights and gunshots.
Dogs bite, using the same melee system as everyone else.
Player and NPC melee hits now sweep along the weapon's swing, with the original timing.
